comment: F5 closes the brush editor it opened. F5 over the canvas opens the editor on the brush in hand, F5 again, with the editor holding the keyboard, closes it, and a third F5 opens it again. Nothing is saved.
01, F5 over the canvas opens the brush editor.
02, F5 again, with the editor focused, puts it away.
03, a third F5 opens it again on the brush in hand.
